ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low contrast ratio; high-intensity (white) pixels constitute approximately 5-8% of the total visible fluke surface compared to the dominant low-intensity (dark grey/black) background.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A near-uniform dark grey base with scattered, high-contrast white circular spots (mottling) of varying sizes (2-12 pixel diameter) distributed across both lobes, with higher frequency in the central lower regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A distinct V-shaped depression at the center with an estimated angle of 70 degrees and a depth relative to lobe height of approximately 1:6.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the trailing edge consisting of peaks and valleys with pixel amplitudes ranging from 2 to 6 pixels, creating a jagged linear boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curves fitted to the lower margins of both lobes, sweeping outward and upward toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple clusters of high-intensity white pixels in roughly circular formations, scattered across the medial and lateral regions of both fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct horizontal linear disruption of white pixels on the left lobe and several shorter, faint vertical linear streaks on the right lobe that diverge from the base pigmentation pattern.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent, brown-toned, textured clusters of high-contrast pixel data protruding from the distal tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.
